research_sources: MagnatesMedia breakdowns — film grain, desaturated grades, slow zooms
ColdFusion tech-docs — dramatic pacing, text reveals, dark palettes
Company Man business-docs — clean data overlays, narrative B-roll
Documentary editing communities — pacing, layering, color science

effects.name: Film grain overlay
effects.description: Subtle grain at 8-15% opacity, varies by mood. Grain increases during tension/dramatic moments.
effects.notes: Use finer grain for modern feel, coarser for archival/nostalgic sections

effects.name: Color grading — warm/cool split
effects.description: Warm golden tones for nostalgia/history, cold blue/steel for modern/crisis sections. Cross-section color shifts mark narrative progression.
effects.notes: Grade shifts should happen at section transitions, not mid-section

effects.name: Subtle vignette
effects.description: Dark vignette at edges, 15-25% opacity. Draws eye to center, adds cinematic feel.
effects.source: Standard documentary/film technique across all analyzed channels

effects.name: Slow zoom / Ken Burns on stills
effects.description: 0.5-2% per second zoom or pan on still photos. Keeps static imagery alive without distraction.
effects.source: MagnatesMedia, ColdFusion — primary technique for still image sections
effects.notes: Always move toward the subject's face or key detail. Never zoom out.

effects.name: Light leak / subtle flare
effects.description: Rare, used only for transitions or key reveals. Adds cinematic texture without overuse.
effects.notes: Use sparingly — max 3-4 per long-form video

effects.name: Animated data overlays
effects.description: Numbers, charts, and financial figures animate in with subtle motion. Text reveals synced to voiceover timing.
effects.notes: Use channel accent color (#C9A227) for key figures

effects.name: Lower third text reveals
effects.description: Name/title overlays for people and companies. Clean sans-serif, slight animation.

effects.name: Dramatic pacing cuts
effects.description: Fast cuts during tension/crisis sections, slow cuts during reflection. Match cutting rhythm to narrative intensity.
effects.notes: Speed up cuts as tension builds, slow down for payoff

effects.name: Depth/parallax layering
effects.description: Separate foreground and background elements with slight movement differential. Adds dimensionality to composites.

effects.name: Chromatic aberration (subtle)
effects.description: Very subtle color fringing at edges during dramatic moments. Never heavy — just enough to feel cinematic.
effects.notes: Max 2-3 uses per video, only at key reveals

pacing_guidelines.opening: Slow, deliberate — let the hook breathe. 2-3 seconds per shot.
pacing_guidelines.climax: Fast cuts, 0.5-1 second per shot. Let tension peak.
pacing_guidelines.resolution: Slow back down. 3-4 seconds per shot. Let the takeaway land.

research_sources: Kurzgesagt — clean gradients, icon-based, smooth transitions

effects.name: Clean gradient backgrounds
effects.description: Smooth, subtle gradients. No texture, no grain. Pure color.

effects.name: Kinetic typography
effects.description: Text that moves with purpose. Words appear, scale, and transition cleanly. No decorative motion.

effects.name: Icon animations
effects.description: Simple, flat icons that animate to illustrate concepts. Clean line-art style.

effects.name: Subtle camera movement
effects.description: Very gentle pan/zoom on elements. Restrained — never aggressive.

pacing_guidelines.opening: Clean, direct. Hook text appears within 1 second.
pacing_guidelines.body: Steady rhythm. 2-3 seconds per visual beat.

research_sources: The Infographics Show — rapid icon sequences, data-driven motion
Half as Interesting — playful geometry, bold colors

effects.name: Layered depth/parallax
effects.description: Multiple layers moving at different speeds. Creates dimensionality.
effects.source: The Infographics Show, Half as Interesting

effects.name: Icon scene compositions
effects.description: Full scenes built from animated icons and flat illustrations. Each scene tells a mini-story.

effects.name: Bold color transitions
effects.description: Full-screen color wipes between sections. High energy, clear section breaks.

effects.name: Data visualization animations
effects.description: Charts, graphs, and numbers that build dynamically. Data tells the story.

effects.name: Character/icon animations
effects.description: Simple characters or icons that act out scenarios. Expressive but not complex.

pacing_guidelines.opening: Fast, energetic. 0.5-1 second per visual beat.
pacing_guidelines.body: Maintain energy. Quick transitions, constant motion.

audit_schedule: Re-audit before each scale-up phase or if engagement drops below baseline
notes: Effects must trace to research. Never add effects because they 'seem cool.' Different styles call for different treatment densities.
